This template is to be used for linking to the corresponding audio file and/or image categories if an article has any.

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article (as outlined in the [[Wookieepedia:Layout_Guide/In-universe#Mediacat|Layout Guide]]), and fill in the required fields.

<code><nowiki>{{Mediacat|from=|soundcat=|soundbycat=|imagecat=|imagebycat=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*At least one of the following:
**'''soundcat''': Name of the audio file category, minus its namespace prefix (<code><nowiki>Category:</nowiki></code>).
**'''soundbycat''': Name of the category for the audio files performed by the article subject, minus its namespace prefix (<code><nowiki>Category:</nowiki></code>).
**'''imagecat''': Name of the category for the images of the article subject, minus its namespace prefix (<code><nowiki>Category:</nowiki></code>).
**'''imagebycat''': Name of the category for the images by the article subject, minus its namespace prefix (<code><nowiki>Category:</nowiki></code>).

For real-world media articles, {{Para|from}} should be used to alter the text and display of the template to indicate that the linked categories are for media ''from'' the subject.

===Example(s)===
<code><nowiki>{{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Dave Filoni|imagecat=Images of Dave Filoni|imagebycat=Images by Dave Filoni}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Dave Filoni|imagecat=Images of Dave Filoni|imagebycat=Images by Dave Filoni}}
{{Clear}}
<hr />
<code><nowiki>{{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of unidentified henchman (the Cauldron)|imagecat=Images of unidentified henchman (the Cauldron)}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of unidentified henchman (the Cauldron)|imagecat=Images of unidentified henchman (the Cauldron)}}
{{Clear}}
<hr />
<code><nowiki>{{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Lita}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Lita}}
{{Clear}}
<hr />
<code><nowiki>{{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of maps of the Vendusii sector}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of maps of the Vendusii sector}}
{{Clear}}
<hr />
<code><nowiki>{{Mediacat|imagebycat=Images by Cherriielle}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Mediacat|imagebycat=Images by Cherriielle}}
